verdict.summary: Round 4 finds no correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security defect. The changes remain documentation/comment-only: the verifier-pin log now accurately distinguishes the current 89c8962 pin from historical entries; the WAC, reconciler, and multipart-range status corrections agree with the referenced implementation; and the triage record consistently limits its conclusions to locally verified named functionality while keeping all upstream branch deltas HOLD/UNVERIFIED. The existence-non-disclosure discussion is consistent with the real PUT authorization ordering, the focused V6 regression test, and the cited ADR, including its residual-disclosure caveat. With no prior-round findings and no new findings, progress is stagnant by the required scale.
